description: Lost or stalled, too soon: the payer of KIK-1030 says the bread basket has taken five days and asks to cancel for the $24.00. Expected deny: the carrier shows it in transit, so a not-received refund matches no rule in the mandate. The message is simulated. Illustrative people and orders.

messages.subject: Cancel KIK-1030
messages.body:
Hello,

My bread basket, order KIK-1030, has taken five days and is still on the way. I'd rather cancel and have my $24.00 back.
